current_activity: Preliminary attacks: captures Cahier and holds it with difficulty against heavy counter-attacks
notes: Event date: 15-17 July 1944 (night of the 15th to the 17th) (Ellis, vol. I, p. 334). Event definition: In the fighting before Goodwood the division, on the right of the 15th Division in XII Corps, captures Cahier, is heavily counter-attacked and only with difficulty keeps its gain. Event support: one source family (Ellis, the British official history). Ellis, Victory in the West, vol. I, p. 334: "On their right 53rd Division captured Cahier but were heavily counter-attacked and only with difficulty maintained their gain". Location: Evrecy, Calvados (new place), standing for the Cahier area on the Evrecy road with a precision of 5 km. Location approximate: the point is Evrecy, the town on the road whose approaches include Cahier; Cahier itself is not located. Location support: Ellis names Cahier but the hamlet is not in the gazetteers used; the Evrecy road it lies on is named in the same paragraph (p. 334).
